title: Republic of Zimbabwe
capsule: Zimbabwe gained independence on 18 April 1980 under Prime Minister Robert Mugabe after a prolonged guerrilla war against the white-minority Rhodesian state, following the Lancaster House Agreement (1979). Mugabe dominated politics for nearly four decades, presiding over land redistribution programmes from 2000 that caused economic collapse, hyperinflation peaking at 89.7 sextillion percent in November 2008, and the suspension of the Zimbabwe dollar. A military-assisted transition in November 2017 ended Mugabe's tenure and installed Emmerson Mnangagwa as president; the country remains landlocked in southern Africa with Harare as its capital.
attestation: Boundaries from Seshat Cliopatria (Bennett et al., Scientific Data 2025; CC BY 4.0), digitized from standard historical atlases at ~0.07° resolution.
